primary: weighted minus uniform official terminal score margin for each same-map same-seat match, equal weight to each map after averaging seats. Summarize each map and each arm W/D/L and seat rates. Each comparison reverses arm order across the two physical seats. Two maps are descriptive. Draws count as zero wins.
secondary: weighted minus true training parent on the same metric; also report uniform minus parent. Account for timeouts and failures in the registered W/D/L denominator, omit nonexistent numeric margins from averages over all and report missing explicitly; never replace any game.
diagnostic: At pre-action states t=60 and 100, record each side current cash, cumulative normal own-bank deliveries, ground-carbon tree rent without cargo tax and the team-minus-opponent difference. Report both seat-paired and map-equal contrasts; diagnosed games with missing state have null at this point. These accounting endpoints do not decide the winner.
execution: Original unmodified public entry at t0, T=1 and unseeded native 0.58 s search, natural independent RNG across arms. Separate offline CPU-only Python3.12/NumPy1.26.4 containers each at 1.5 CPU and 512MiB, per-game cold init and bidirectional parsed I/O timing including step0, ranked limits, external clock, memory and search diagnostic, no filtering on outcome or depth. All arm games in a seed-seat are serial on the same host and affinity. No comparisons to the latest eight training boards, no official exam.
